property_summary: For every call to Put by any sender with any payable amount, the reference contract always records a Log.AddMessage entry (so History length increases by 1 and last message matches sender and value); the mutant that deletes the logging call does not, so for some inputs the History does not grow and the property is violated.
change_summary: Replace the LogFile.AddMessage call with a no-op (delete the logging call), removing the emitted log message effect of Put.
